description: The opening setup of an interactive story

fields.CharacterSeed.aliases: Other names and nicknames, at most 6
fields.CharacterSeed.summary: Looks, personality, way of speaking, motives; at most 500 characters
fields.CharacterSeed.attitude: Attitude toward the protagonist, at most 160 characters
fields.CharacterSeed.speech_style: Way of speaking and catchphrases, at most 240 characters
fields.FactSeed.text: One atomic fact, at most 200 characters
fields.FactSeed.secret: A secret the protagonist doesn't know at first
fields.FactSeed.known_by: Names of the characters who know this secret
fields.ItemSeed.summary: Looks, origin and use; at most 300 characters
fields.ItemSeed.holder: Name of the character holding it; use either this or location
fields.ItemSeed.location: Name of the place where it is
fields.LocationSeed.summary: Looks, atmosphere and exits; at most 400 characters
fields.OpeningBrief.location: Name of the opening location (must be in locations)
fields.OpeningBrief.present: Names of the characters present at the opening, not including the protagonist
fields.OpeningBrief.situation: The opening situation: what the protagonist is doing and what just happened; at most 500 characters
fields.OpeningBrief.hook: The first hook that sets the story moving, at most 200 characters
fields.OrgSeed.summary: Purpose, structure and way of operating; at most 300 characters
fields.OrgSeed.stance: Stance toward the protagonist, at most 120 characters
fields.ProtagonistSeed.name: The protagonist's name (the "I" the player plays)
fields.ProtagonistSeed.summary: Looks, identity and personality; at most 400 characters
fields.ProtagonistSeed.goal: The protagonist's goal at the opening, at most 160 characters
fields.WorldSeed.title: Name of the story or world, at most 40 characters
fields.WorldSeed.setting: The world: era, place, society, supernatural rules and so on; at most 800 characters
fields.WorldSeed.tone: Tone and atmosphere, at most 200 characters
fields.WorldSeed.rules: World rules that must be followed, at most 8
